name: Siti
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Alla, N'Guessan Edmonde-Andrea. 2020. Elements phonologique et grammatical du cira / siti, langue en danger de Cote d'Ivoire: une premiere approche.
earlier_scan.note: First phonological-grammatical approach to Siti/Cira exists (per Glottolog, listed by Glottolog as a phonology); no online copy located.

sources.citation: Delafosse, Maurice. 1904. Vocabulaires comparatifs de plus de 60 langues ou dialectes parlés à la Côte d'Ivoire et dans les régions limitrophes. Paris: Ernest Leroux.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only a book-wide note (p. 3) that 'l'accent tonique ou plutôt l'intonation' cannot be indicated by alphabetic signs; ~90 Siti words with no Siti-specific accent statement.

sources.citation: Alla, N'Guessan Edmonde-Andréa. 2022. La détermination nominale du cira. Akofena Hors-série n°02 (Actes du 4ème Colloque international de Kodjoboué-Bonoua, 6-7 oct. 2022), vol. 1: 123-134. DOI 10.48734/akofena.hs02.10.2022.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Morphosyntax of determiners; examples carry tone marks (m̀ bì 'mon enfant', bìrgà 'enfants') but no statement on tone, stress or accent; cites Alla (2020) as covering the phonological aspect.

sources.citation: Brindle, Jonathan Allen & Enoc Kra. 2012. Siti/Kyitu; an endangered language of Côte d'Ivoire. Ghana Journal of Linguistics 1(2): 67-76 (ELDP project report).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic/project report; transcribes names with tone diacritics ([kʲɪ̄tʊ̀] 'Kyitu', [sɪ́tɪ́gɛ́]) but contains no statement on tone, stress or accent; says explicitly that no self-standing description exists yet (p. 74).

sources.citation: Tauxier, Louis. 1921. Le noir de Bondoukou: Koulangos, Dyoulas, Abrons, etc. Paris: Ernest Leroux.

sources.note: The only work Glottolog classes as a phonology of Siti; a French-school phonological sketch would normally have a section on tons and possibly accent. Author reachable at andreaalla20@gmail.com (from Alla 2022).
